violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: shredded lettuce (46F), sliced tomatoes (47F), sliced cheese (46F) in #2.
violations.corrective_action: The CFM jumped into action and discarded the TCS food items in the refrigeration unit, assess the unit and taking it out of commission. The unit thermometer registered a false appropriate temperature. Maintenance was onsite for immediate repairs.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: 2 dr under counter passthrough unit at expo (59F)
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PIC removed all TCS food items from unit and contacted repair technician. PIC will discontinue use of unit until repair is complete and unit is able to maintain an ambient temperature of 41F or below.
